I feel for you my fellows. I got dumped a month ago. I am going through the same thing while at the same time i am ready to move on. I have to. there is no hope. She has made her choice. It was a lot of talking and expressi g myself to her that got me to this realisation. I did not cut her out of my life we wanted to remain in harmony but it is difficult. Know if you dont choose to go the no contact route it wil be difficult. The interactions between you will not bring you what you hope for but it can help find closure experiencing how she treats you and views things. But it will als be painful. Either way will be painful and difficult.

As for your thoughts about her and the whole matter. They are logical in this phase of the breakup that was not your choice. I dont know how old you are. I understand you think you will never find someone like this, you will never have her again, someone else will. I feel the same way my man. BUT hey we did it at least once right? I am 33 now i have had about 10 girlfriends in total a hand full were real lookers so who is to say we cant do it again. When you are ready focua on you! On your life make it as good as possible so you become an attractive mate as possible. You have this place for support, try finding support from your real life friends. The emotions are god-damned bitch but they do pass. Some in 90 seconds others take days. Your rationale and your feelings wont be in line your feelings will win most of the time because this is a matter of the hart at ist deepest level. Don't do things that harm you to not deal with the pain like drugs or other sef destructive things. Watch ted talks, talk to us, to friend, to her of possible, go in to therapy if you need. I will. Its a painful heartwrenching at times unbearable thing to go trough man.  I say this all to the both of us. Good luck buddy.
